items.title: Unicorns!
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay in cute unicorn attire!

+ 10 unicorn skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Red Vs Green
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Who's gonna win? Challenge your friends and choose these skins for a battle. It's up to you whether you're on the red team or the green team. All of these characters are ready for all kinds of role-playing, and most importantly, lots of fun!

- 6 awesome skins included!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from BreadBuilds.

items.title: Robo Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Rock out as a robot with these Minecraft-themed Robo skins all around the infinite world, all the way to the end. Protect and defend your realm!

items.title: Mob Ninjas HD
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These HD Mob Ninja styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs! Dress as Tegashon, or wear a creeper-themed outfit!

items.title: Safari Camp
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Feeling wild? This pack is perfect for you! Animal print never goes out of style! You can rock these fierce skins and show off your wild side!

+ 12 unique skins for you to choose from!

items.title: Emerald Tools
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
Netherite just isn’t good enough anymore. Craft your emerald pickaxe, sword, and axe and mine faster than ever before with new modded emerald tools, weapons and armor.

+ 33 Emerald tools and weapons
+ Full set of custom emerald armor
+ Castle build to start off your adventure

items.title: Creeper Masters
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Behold! Choose from 10 Creeper skins, each decked out in royal attire. Whether you are the ruler of the undead or of the elements, conquer the world with these frightening skins!

items.title: Candy Paradise
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: In a dangerous world, the only safe place is the candy paradise! Explore this cute and colorful town where everything is made of candies!

items.title: Pastel High School Teens
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
High school gets better with pastel outfits. Pick your pastel teen style today!

- 21 colorful skins

items.title: Rainbow Buddies
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Rainbow buddies are out to rise and shine!

- 21 colorful skins

items.title: Rainbow Fashion Teens
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Rainbow style is taking over the fashion industry!

- 21 rainbow skins

items.title: Rainbow Gamers
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Rainbow Gamers are out to seize the gaming world! 

- 19 Cool skins

items.title: Derpy Cyborgs
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Are you ready for some cute fun derpy skins!
* 20 cool skins!

items.title: Wizards
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Do you feel the magic that surrounds you? Does it flow through you, guide your way? You must have special powers and are a lover of wizards. From now on you can protect your world through pure magic and live freely.

+ 10 different skins
+ Dark wizard
+ Light wizard
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Farmers
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Farm life is exactly your thing and you feel so free in the role of a farmer? With this package, you have the opportunity to jump into those roles and indulge in life in the field.

+ 10 different skins
+ Several different styles
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Dragon Pets
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Discover and tame tons of pet dragons here in the world of Dragon Pets! Test your luck with the egg machine and hatch a common, uncommon, rare, or legendary pet! Collect coins from killing monsters and stay on a huge castle to help you beat the night!

+ 30x dragon types!
+ Egg rarity features!
+ Tame, feed, and fight!
+ Play on singleplayer and multiplayer!

items.title: Summer Fling
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Jump high up in the air and turn off your anime show, it’s Summer! Feel fit, feel cute, feel pretty, and feel that fashion with these adorable Summer teens! Take long adventurous trips in your modern city and feel that cool wind blow among your face. These skins are ready for some summer action, are you?

-10 beach themed skins!
-By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Rap Star
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The rap game respects your work young artist. Game recognize game. It's time to show the world what you've got!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Casual and luxury attire inspired by modern artists!

items.title: Anime Sunflower HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
You're a sunflower! Enjoy this super kawaii pack featuring anime styled teens dressed in sunflower fashion. Traditional kimonos, school outfits, and everyday wear included. Great for summer and fall!

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Dark Matter
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: There exists beyond the scope of our perception a form of matter that imbues darkness. Its form is unable to be interacted with or even seen, yet somehow it watches us. You will know its presence by a sharp sense of being watched while no one is around. Is something or someone watching us?

items.title: Skyblock Economy
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Skyblock now has an economy. Gather supplies and trade with shops for money and then use that money to buy materials for your adventure. Socialize with the locals at the tavern for handy tips, stories, or even limited time deals.
-Custom Nether
-General Store
-Tavern
-Bank
-Lumber Mill
-Stables
-Mining Outpost
-Farm
-Flower Shop
-Hunting Camp
-Fishery
-Masonry
-And more...

items.title: I Love MC
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Your love for Minecraft is apparent. It is all you talk about with friends. Don’t be ashamed and wear a skin that shows your dedication to the game you love. We love MC too.

items.title: Heroes
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Every hero has a backstory. Don a mask and develop your own with one of these five, soon to be famous, superheroes. At last you can stop crime in your Minecraft world and finally become a legend amongst your friends.

items.title: Food Heads
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
As the saying goes, you are what you eat. Why not take the phrase literally and become a human food hybrid.
- Apple
- Chocolate bar
- Burger
- Taco
- Cake
